QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Rescue Neinheart
QuestInfo.0: What will #bChief Alex#k in #bHenesys Ruins#k decide to do when he hears that Neinheart is locked up? Go and talk to Chief Alex.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Chief Alex, Neinheart was confined because disagreed with the Empress's conquest of Maple World. Neinheart must have all sorts of information about the Knights and the stronghold.

The informant says Neinheart is in the Secret Grove in #bKnight District 4#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met Neinheart and explained the status of Henesys Ruins. He said there's still hope...

default.0: According to the informant, you can meet #bNeinheart#k by going to the #bSecret Grove#k from #bKnight District 4#k.
